name: Market Identification 87
definition: Identifies the market and purpose for the settlement.

Country.name: Country
Country.definition: Country in which the financial instrument is to be settled.

ClassificationType.name: Classification Type
ClassificationType.definition: Type of instrument covered by the SSI instruction.

SettlementPurpose.name: Settlement Purpose
SettlementPurpose.definition: Purpose of the instruction, for example, whether for regular payments, margin payments related to a collateral movement, securities settlements, securities lending.
